name: The Property Developer
archetype: A develop-build-hold real estate company — land, entitlement, construction, leasing

ca.what: Zoning, site plan approval and building permits — the municipal gate every project passes through from rezoning to occupancy.
New-home warranty and builder licensing — vendor registration, deposit protection and warranty claim standards.

ca.full: Technical Standards and Safety Authority / provincial building-code authorities
ca.what: Technical safety and code compliance — elevating devices, boilers and pressure vessels, fuel systems.

uk.what: Planning permission, s106 obligations and discharge of conditions under the town and country planning regime.
Building control and gateway approvals for higher-risk buildings under the Building Safety Act.
Construction site safety — CDM 2015 duties, notifications, inspections and enforcement.

roles.title: Board of Directors
roles.about: Elected by shareholders to govern the developer. Approves land acquisitions, project proformas and debt strategy, and holds the CEO to account. Works through its Audit, Investment, Compensation and ESG committees.
